bounded_resolution: Retain Operations Research as a composition/index family, not a single semantic authority. Decision-problem and objective/constraint policy, mathematical optimization IR, solver capability/execution, exact solution validation/infeasibility, heuristic search, queueing, and simulation each retain distinct formalism-specific evidence and result-strength rules. Governed business selection remains outside every solver/method owner.

formalism_partitions.owner_rule: domain decision owner supplies objective/preference/constraint authority; OR libraries type and compare declared structures only
model formalism plus solver/certificate contracts; exact/feasible/optimal/infeasible/unbounded are evidence-scoped statuses
candidate generation/search with bounded quality claim; no optimality implication absent proof
conceptual model, experiment, random streams, execution and V&V remain separate; simulated outcome is not observed reality

noncollapse_laws: decision problem != optimization model != solver run != result != selected action
infeasibility diagnosis != authority to relax a constraint
benchmark performance != semantic or business fitness
invalidation_condition: Reopen on a new OR formalism that cannot be expressed by an existing partition or evidence that invalidates a result-strength/noncollapse law.

bounded_resolution: Retain Forecasting Lifecycle as an operated composition of four authorities: forecast definition/temporal-information contract; estimator and forecast-evaluation method semantics; immutable edition/provenance lifecycle; and explicit human selection/override/publication governance. No one source owns all four. Forecasts remain distinct from scenarios, plans, commitments, approvals and downstream actions.

authority_layers.owns: target, population/unit/grain, observation/vintage, reference/origin/horizon/information-cut, output form and uncertainty declaration
run/artifact/edition/supersession/effective/expiry identity and provenance without rewriting prior vintages
declared profile, appraisal, authorized override, approval/publication/recall; imports methods but cannot alter their evidence

noncollapse_laws: target != observation != actual != forecast != plan != decision != outcome
reference/origin time != validity time != generation time != publication time
override proposal != approved override != published forecast
new information cut or material revision => new edition, not history rewrite
invalidation_condition: Reopen when a forecast modality introduces temporal, probabilistic, revision or governance semantics not representable by these layers.
